October 20, 2026

💢 A “Protest” to the Allied Commander, a “Request for Support” to China’s Ambassador

At an October 15 parliamentary audit, South Korea’s Defense Minister Kang Shin-chul stated that Seoul had “already conveyed” its objection to remarks by USFK Commander Gen. Brunson.

Just five days later, before Chinese Ambassador Dai Bing, he requested China's “active support” and a “constructive role.”

The same China that repeatedly enters South Korea’s Air Defense Identification Zone (KADIZ) and builds structures in the Yellow Sea.

Protesting to an ally while asking China for peace.

That is the security compass of this fake government.
